name: lucid-rules-2026-11-09
label: simulated using Lucid Trading's published rules as read on 2026-11-09; not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucid
howRead: Lucid Trading's help center (support.lucidtrading.com), read-only, no login, with a page-reading tool (WebFetch) that returns quoted sentences; the quotes below are as that tool returned them and should be checked against the pages before any reliance. lucidtrading.com itself (the product and price pages) refused the tool with HTTP 403, so prices and the LucidFlex daily-loss-limit amounts could not be read from Lucid.

allowedHours.value: positions closed by 16:45 Eastern Monday to Friday; trading resumes 18:00 Eastern Sunday to Thursday; on holidays with altered closes, flat before the market closes
sentences: All positions must be closed by 4:45 PM EST, Monday through Friday
Any open positions will be automatically closed by Lucid Trading at 4:45 PM EST
Important: Holding a position past this time does not result in a failed account
Trading resumes at 6:00 PM EST, Sunday through Thursday
On market holidays with altered closing times, all positions must be closed before the market closes,
allowedHours.simulated: every position is closed by the programme's own flat-by time (earlier than 16:45 Eastern; CAMPAIGN-1.md), and on early-close days before the close

newsLucidFlexProDirect.value: no news restriction on these plans
sentences: Traders may enter or exit positions around scheduled or unscheduled news events on these plans without it being a breach

newsLucidDaily.value: trading red-folder news is a hard breach on LucidDaily; the events and the minutes around them are not defined on the page
sentences: Trading red folder news on the LucidDaily is a hard breach
newsLucidDaily.unclear: which events count and for how long are not stated; no economic calendar exists in the data, so LucidDaily is recorded but not simulated

sentences: Automated trading systems and trade copiers are permitted
All automated activity must comply with Lucid Trading rules

microscalping.value: flagged when more than 50% of profits come from trades held 5 seconds or less
sentences: More than 50% of your profits are generated from trades held for 5 seconds or less
microscalping.simulated: no simulated trade is shorter than one 1-minute bar, so the rule cannot bind

dailyLossLimitNature.value: every daily loss limit is a soft breach: trading stops until the next session, the account is not failed
sentences: All DLLs at Lucid Trading are considered soft breaches, meaning you do not lose your account for hitting DLL
as long as the Max Loss Limit (MLL) has not been reached.
dailyLossLimitNature.unclear: whether open (unrealized) losses count is not stated
dailyLossLimitNature.simulated: realized plus open losses (stricter): when the day's result including the open position touches minus the limit, the position is closed at that price and no further trade is taken that session

breachBasis.value: the account breaches when its balance reaches the Max Loss Limit
sentences: If your account balance reached the MLL, your account will be breached.
breachBasis.unclear: 'balance' could mean the closed balance or the live balance including open profit and loss
readings: live balance including the open position
breachBasis.simulated: the live balance including the open position at each 1-minute bar's adverse extreme (stricter)

commissions.value: not published on the pages read
commissions.assumption: experimental assumption (author-selected): US$0.50 per micro contract per side and US$2.00 per mini contract per side, all-in

fees.value: evaluation prices are not on the help pages; lucidtrading.com refused the page-reading tool
sentences: LucidPro Evaluation and LucidDirect accounts are purchased by paying a one-time fee.
There is no activation fee to upgrade a LucidPro Evaluation to a LucidPro Funded.
Resets are not automatic or free.
fees.simulated: experimental assumption (author-selected), from unverified third-party listings, the higher figure where they disagree: LucidFlex 50K US$175, LucidPro 50K US$129.50; every report also gives the result before fees

sentences: The LucidFlex evaluation is a simulated account with a profit target that must be hit before traders are eligible
to upgrade to a LucidFlex funded account.
profitTarget.table: Account Size | Profit Target | Max Loss Limit | Consistency % | Max Size: $50,000 | $3,000 | $2,000 | 40% (50% with add-on) | 4 mini or 40 micros

sentences: use an End-of-Day Drawdown (EOD Drawdown) system to calculate the Max Loss Limit (MLL)
At the end of each trading session, the system calculates the account's highest closing balance
The MLL increases as your balance grows, up to a defined point
Once your account exceeds the Initial Trail Balance, the MLL locks and no longer moves
Once the account exceeds the trail, the MLL locks at the initial balance plus $100
Once you request a payout from LucidFlex, your MLL automatically adjusts to the Locked MLL Balance
maxLoss.table: Account Size | MLL Amount | Initial Trail Balance | Locked MLL Balance: $50,000 | $2,000 | $52,100 | $50,100
maxLoss.trailing: end of day: MLL = min(highest closing balance - MLL Amount, initial balance + $100), updated at each session's close; does not follow open profit (it trails closing balances)
maxLoss.evaluationAndFunded: the same EOD system in both stages (the page lists no difference)

sentences: The DLL is a soft breach, so if you hit it you will simply be locked out until the next trading session.
dailyLossLimit.value: optional at purchase (DLL On lowers the price); the amounts are not on the help pages
dailyLossLimit.simulated: DLL Off (a published option whose rules are fully known)

sentences: Largest Single Day Profit / Account Profit = Consistency Percentage
your Consistency Percentage must be 40% or less to be eligible to upgrade to a LucidFlex funded account.
The consistency requirement (40%, or 50% with the add-on) applies only during the evaluation stage.
consistency.fundedSentence: There is no Consistency Percentage on LucidFlex funded accounts
consistency.simulated: 40% (the default; stricter than the 50% add-on), checked when the target is reached: if the largest day is above 40% of the profit, trading continues until it is not

sentences: Pass in as few as 3 days with 40% consistency, or 2 days with the 50% consistency add-on
minimumTradingDays.value: no separate minimum stated; the 40% consistency rule implies at least 3 profitable days
minimumTradingDays.simulated: no minimum beyond the consistency rule

sentences: There is no scaling plan in the evaluation phase.
The scaling plan updates at the end of each session, so your limits will not update in real-time throughout the day.
contractLimits.simulated: evaluation 40 micros; funded by profit at the previous session's close (20, 30, 40 micros)

sentences: One-time fee, no monthly rebilling, take as long as you need to pass
timeLimit.simulated: no time limit by rule; the simulation stops an attempt after an author-selected horizon (CAMPAIGN-1.md) and reports it as timed out

sentences: LucidFlex funded accounts have an optional Daily Loss Limit, no consistency rule and no payout buffer.
90/10 profit split.
EOD trailing drawdown.
No activation fees to upgrade to funded account
Traders must earn at least the minimum required profit on 5 separate days during the payout cycle.
Traders must have positive net profit (even just $1) during each payout cycle in order to request a payout.
Minimum payout request: $500
Futures traders may request 50% of their account balance up to a maximum dollar amount.
There is no buffer balance that must be maintained in LucidFlex funded accounts.
All LucidFlex funded account payouts are split 90% to the trader and 10% to Lucid Trading.
payout.table: Account Size | Minimum Daily Profit: $50,000 | $150; Payout Maximum: $50,000 | 50% of Profit up to $2,000
payout.unclear: '50% of their account balance' (a sentence) against '50% of Profit up to $2,000' (the table)
payout.simulated: 50% of the profit, capped at $2,000 (stricter); at least $500, else the trader keeps trading; the trader receives 90%

sentences: LucidPro evaluation accounts: $25K-$150K accounts, profit targets from $1,250,
Pass the evaluation in one trading day
profitTarget.table: Account Size | Profit Target | Max Loss Limit | Daily Loss Limit | Max Size: $50,000 | $3,000 | $2,000 | $1,200 | 4 mini or 40 micros

sentences: use an End-of-Day Drawdown (EOD Drawdown) system to calculate the Max Loss Limit (MLL).
At the end of each trading session, the system calculates the account's highest closing balance

consistency.evaluation: no evaluation consistency rule on the pages read
consistency.simulated: none in the evaluation; 40% within the payout cycle in the funded stage

sentences: No scaling plan, access to max contract size immediately
contractLimits.value: 4 mini or 40 micros (50K) in both stages
